Name: AT - Zaoux's Pride Flag Banners for Alternative Textures
Author: zaoux
Description:
[center]Basic Mod that adds 45 different Pride flags to your game using Alternative Textures!
Alternative Textures version of my original (and first!) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10065]CF - Zaoux's Pride Flag Banner[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10065]s[/url]﻿ Mod

[b]~ Installation ~[/b]
1. Unzip in your mods folder and run the game
2. That's literally it!

[b]~ How to use ~[/b]
1. Obtain the Paint Bucket from Robin
[i] ﻿The flags may show up regardless if you have this item, if you have randomisation of textures on,
﻿but you can't select which one unless you have the Bucket.
[/i]2. Right click on any Banner you can find - These have been added to all banners currently in the game!
3. Choose your flag
4. Profit![/center]
